name: VABAR
subtitle: 工业与机房场景的六类操作任务，按 goal clause 逐条判定成功
version: vabar_v1.json v1.0（12 cells × 30 冻结实例）· 仓库 cc9e2d3

officialDefinition.summary: 在六类工业与机房任务上评操作策略，按 goal clause 逐条判成功。
officialDefinition.task: 六个任务类各分两个难度，共 12 个 cell、每 cell 30 条冻结实例；agent 需操作 Franka 或 YAM 双臂完成该实例 task 文档里声明的 goal。

taskContract.input: cell 的 30 条冻结实例（task 与 episode 编号）加对应的 task 文档：objects、fixtures、goal clause、相机与物理配置、最大步数。
taskContract.output: 驱动双臂完成 goal 的操作；参考解是仓库里每个任务自带的 scripted routine 与 Graph-as-Policy 参考图。
taskContract.environment: 经 RoboSimStudio 跑在 Newton 物理引擎上，需 Linux、NVIDIA GPU、Python 3.12 与 uv；感知图另需 SAM 3 等模型。

dataProfile.summary: 12 个 cell（6 任务类 × 2 难度），每 cell 30 条冻结实例，共 360 条。
scale: 清单 version 为 1.0，instances_per_cell 为 30；六类任务分别是工具分拣、工具悬挂、齿轮啮合、注射器装箱、USB-C 插接与线缆布线。
splits: cell 名形如 tool_hanging/L1；每个 cell 的 selection 字段说明取自哪份 manifest、前多少条，例如前 30 条取自 100 条冻结实例。
fields: 每条实例记 id、task、episode、document 路径与 initial 位姿；cell 另记 task_class、level、suite、graph、flags 与 selection。
files: task 文档是 RoboSimStudio 文档格式（.task，Lisp 风格），同族共享 <suite>.suite；graphs/<label>/ 放参考 GaP 图。

requirements: 仓库与冻结清单公开可读；完整复跑需 Linux、NVIDIA GPU 与约 12 GB 依赖，感知图另需配置 HF_TOKEN。

sampleAccess.reason: 默认展示一条冻结实例的 task 文档全文，含 :language、:objects、:goal 与 :instance-layout。

metric.name: clause 判定的成功率（按 trial 计）
metric.description: goal 逐条 clause 判定：对象彼此独立的任务（如逐个分拣或悬挂）以单个对象为 trial，取完成比例，工具须离手一秒才算完成；顺序型任务（如齿轮啮合）以整条实例为单位，子目标只作诊断。cycle time 取成功 trial 的中位数。

limitations.text: 本轮没有安装依赖或运行 bench，本页不含任何成功率或 cycle time 数值。

第三方机器人模型与场景资产各自带许可，公开仓库的 Apache-2.0 不自动覆盖它们。

samples.title: 工具悬挂 Level 1：把扳手挂到挂钩上并松手
samples.prompt:
起始条件：tool_hanging/L1 cell 的第 1 条冻结实例（seed 1），场景含一个 1.30 倍放大的 260 mm 活动扳手与一个挂板挂钩，双臂为 YAM。

任务：把扳手挂到挂钩上，并在松手后保持住。

交付：由策略驱动的双臂动作；参考解是该任务自带的 HangWrenchRoutineLevel1 脚本与参考 GaP 图。
验收：goal 里的 clause 全部成立并维持 1 秒——环套住钩杆、接触力不低于 0.2、速度不高于 0.15、双手离物体超过 0.21。

raw.toolhanging-easy-hangwrench-001.task:
; -*- mode: lisp -*-
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; LEVEL 1 -- one hook, one object. See wrenches.task for the family's design
; (what `encloses`/`contact-force`/`speed`/`hold-for` mean) and
; tasks/tool_hanging/task.py's LEVEL1_Y for the centring. Does not touch
; wrenches.task or any other existing document.
;
; The single object is a uniformly enlarged (1.30x) version of the task's
; 200 mm wrench. Its visual mesh, collision hulls and declared ring feature use
; the same scale; the graph continues to estimate its manipulation geometry
; from camera observations.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

(define (problem TOOLHANGING-EASY-HANGWRENCH-001)

  (:domain tool_hanging)

  (:language hang the wrench on the hook)

  (:staging
    (:scene tool_hanging_bench)
    (:embodiment yam_tool_hanging (:work-arm left) (:support-arm right))
    (:physics tool_hanging_480hz@v1)
    (:cameras tool_hanging_views_level1@v2)
    (:control-mode joint_position)
    (:episodes (:count 1) (:seed 1) (:sampler fixed))
    ; Learned multi-camera graph calls and closed-loop Cartesian moves are
    ; slower than the scripted routine; 6200 lets gap_perception release and
    ; retract (measured completion: 5796) without changing either policy.
    (:max-steps 6200)
  )

  (:objects
    wrench_1 - wrench_adjustable_260
  )

  (:fixtures
    wrench_hook_1 - pegboard_hook
  )

  (:init)

  (:goal
    ; Each tool hung and let go, for a second: see tool_hanging.suite for the release clause.
    (And
      (hold-for 1.0
        (And
          (encloses wrench_1.ring wrench_hook_1.shank)
          (>= (contact-force wrench_1 wrench_hook_1) 0.2)
          (<= (speed wrench_1) 0.15)
          (> (hands-clear wrench_1) 0.21)
        )
      )
    )
  )

  (:reward (fraction))

  (:observe
    (encloses wrench_1.ring wrench_hook_1.shank)
  )

  (:artifacts
    (:routine "routine:HangWrenchRoutineLevel1")
    (:tools "tools:register_tool_hanging_tools")
    (:graph gt "graphs/gt")
    (:graph gap_gt "graphs/gap_gt")
    (:graph gap_perception "graphs/gap_perception")
  )

  (:provenance
    (:tier original)
    (:source "A one-object, one-holder reduction of wrenches.task, authored
              for GaP graph testing. The Level-1 wrench is uniformly enlarged;
              the scene and holder remain unchanged.")
    (:note "HangWrenchRoutineLevel1 (tasks/tool_hanging/routine.py) is
            HangWrenchRoutine trimmed to one job -- wrench_1, left arm,
            hook_center_world_y=LEVEL1_Y -- carrying uniformly scaled grasp
            and ring landmarks for the enlarged wrench.")
  )


  (:instance-layout
    (:source-task tool_hanging/wrenches_level1)
    (:source-episode 1)
    (:seed 1)
    (:object-xform wrench_1 0.0004728649880102673 0.01801854785303741 0.009099999999999997 0.7071067811865476 0.0 0.0 0.7071067811865476)
  )
)
